proposal.summary: The Crestron HD-MD4X2-4K-E 1.0.0.2159 administrative web interface discloses user credentials when accessed unauthenticated: aj.html returns a JSON document containing uname and upassword fields.
proposal.cwe_quote: aj.html sends a JSON document with uname and upassword fields.

AV.quote: When the administrative web interface of the HDMI switcher is accessed unauthenticated, user credentials are disclosed

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the behavior by requesting aj.html on an unpatched device to reproduce the JSON response, capture the uname/upassword values, and determine whether those credentials can authenticate to the web interface; then coordinate disclosure with the vendor and advise removing sensitive data from unauthenticated responses and rotating exposed credentials.
